hypotheses.H1_gru: The prior frozen 0.1% five-check plateau gate was not met despite competent signed action-effect predictions; a new experiment must distinguish persistent optimizer oscillation from progress or overfitting, not relabel the previous FAIL.
hypotheses.H2_krr: The original uncentered target kernel ridge regression is not equivariant to a uniform target offset because ridge shrinkage pulls far-away predictions toward zero.
hypotheses.H3_krr_residual: A train-only residual-to-current-sensor target produces shift-equivariant predictions under equal offsets applied to both current sensor and next sensor, separating offset extrapolation from raw-kernel representation errors.
hypotheses.H0: New target centering/residualization does not improve disjoint validation error or signed action-effect competence over the original six-grid raw-target KRR; GRU diagnostic stability does not translate to competent previously unseen worlds.
